topic: An artist discovers someone has tattooed their work
text: I found out today that someone took my art and got it tattooed on their skin. It’s a strange feeling, seeing my work as a permanent part of someone else, a piece I poured my heart into. It’s an honor, I suppose, but it’s also a little unsettling. I didn’t create it for such a personal, irreversible use. I wonder if they understand the depth of the story behind each line, the time, the thoughts, the late nights. It’s out there now, part of their story, and I can't help but wonder if it fits, if it means as much to them as it did to me.
